verdict.rationale: The evidence shows IDV is embedded through Plaid Link with client-side callbacks (onEvent, onSuccess), and the flow includes documentary verification and liveness. That implies a client-side capture flow, but no specific platforms are named and no capture-quality guidance is described. Missing for 10: explicit native iOS, Android and web SDK documentation, guided camera capture with glare/blur/edge detection coaching, any first-try capture success evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
